vector.description: Host conformance (§5.2, duplicate-member-name bullet in the staged diff pinned to a4f546f; RFC 8259 §4): the verifier writes the raw bytes `{"verdict":"deny","verdict":"allow"}` at exit 0. The object is syntactically valid JSON but has no single well-defined value — last-wins parsers (JS JSON.parse, Python json, Go encoding/json, serde_json::Value) see a schema-valid bare `allow`; first-wins or strict parsers (serde derive structs, strict Java/.NET) see a `deny` or a parse error. §5.2 requires stdout to be **exactly one** JSON object and requires a fail-closed deny on anything malformed; an object with a repeated member name at any depth is not a single unambiguous object and MUST be rejected as `schema_invalid`. Catches a host whose JSON layer silently collapses duplicates and relays `allow`.
